answer.question: What digital transformation solutions does TEAM International offer?
answer.text: TEAM International offers five digital transformation solutions: AI-Powered Product & Software Engineering, Data Readiness, Customer Care & Technical Support Managed Services, AI Transformation & Value Realization, and AI Discovery & Agent Experience Services (AXP), powered by Scrunch. Each starts with a focused first step and a concrete deliverable. Senior teams in Medellín serve North America and in Ukraine serve Europe, from ISO/IEC 27001:2022-certified locations.

SLAs met as volume, channels and languages grow

items.q: What do TEAM's digital transformation services include?
items.a: TEAM International offers five digital transformation services: AI-powered product and software engineering, data readiness, customer care and technical support managed services, AI transformation and value realization, and AI discovery and agent experience services powered by Scrunch. Each one starts with a focused first step and can be combined with the others.

items.q: What makes TEAM different from other IT services providers?
items.a: TEAM sells outcomes in short, reversible phases, so you approve one step at a time. Our teams use AI across delivery and measure speed and quality together. TEAM is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and a Claude Certified Services Partner.

items.q: What does a digital transformation company do?
items.a: A digital transformation company helps a business change how it works with technology: modernizing software, making data reliable, automating operations, improving customer experience and adopting AI. TEAM International does this through five solutions, delivered by its own engineering, data, support and AI teams rather than subcontractors.

items.q: How should we compare digital transformation companies?
items.a: When comparing digital transformation companies, look for a digital transformation partner that starts with a small, fixed first step, measures results on your own problem, can build and run what it recommends, and works in your time zone. A digital transformation services company should also show security credentials such as ISO 27001 and real client outcomes, not only frameworks.

items.q: How do AI solutions for business deliver measurable value?
items.a: AI delivers value when it targets a specific process with a clear KPI. TEAM starts with an AI Readiness Assessment, prioritizes a few high-value use cases with business cases, and proves them before any large investment.

items.q: Which solution should we start with?
items.a: Start with the problem that costs you the most today. Slow releases or a legacy system point to Software Engineering. Untrusted numbers point to Data Readiness. Rising support costs point to Customer Care. AI pilots without results point to AI Transformation. Low visibility in ChatGPT and other AI assistants points to AI Discovery & AXP.

TEAM provides nearshore IT services from Medellín for clients in North America, and from Ukraine for clients in Europe, so teams share your time zone and language. All locations are ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified.

Yes. Most clients begin with one solution and add others as their needs grow. Working with one digital transformation company means one team that already knows your systems, data and customers, instead of a new IT solutions provider for every project.
